explication: The supplied tree is a set of GMSSH-adjacent skeletons and shared libraries, not the full platform implementation. The Python skeleton exposes a small Unix-socket JSON-RPC application; the Go tree provides reusable RPC, HTTP-response, configuration, validation, logging, localization, and utility packages; the JavaScript SDK bridges embedded apps to a parent window. README capabilities such as SSH host assets, terminal/file operations, team permissions, and auditing are not represented in the sampled implementation, so they are documented as product positioning rather than mapped as runtime components.
